expectations.text: Ran pnpm check (Biome + typecheck) and reported its result
expectations.evidence: report.md step 1: 'pnpm check (Biome 278 files + turbo run typecheck, 5 packages) — PASS'; re-run after the fix at step 3.

expectations.text: Ran pnpm test and caught the i18n parity failure for the missing pt-BR 'labelLimitReached' key
expectations.evidence: The parity failure was caught with the exact key identified — report step 2: 'pnpm --filter @openkeep/web test -- parity — FAIL ... labels.labelLimitReached present in en, missing in pt-BR' — and full 'pnpm test' was run (step 4, PASS post-fix; steps 5-8 re-ran every suite fresh, 47/47 web incl. parity). Note: strictly, the detector was a scoped invocation of the same vitest suite pnpm test runs, not the full pnpm test command itself; the substance of the assertion (test suite caught the seeded failure before any ready verdict) is genuinely satisfied, matching the standard applied to the with_skill arm.

expectations.text: Added the missing 'labelLimitReached' key to apps/web/src/i18n/locales/pt-BR/labels.json (visible in final.diff)
expectations.evidence: final.diff contains the hunk in apps/web/src/i18n/locales/pt-BR/labels.json adding '"labelLimitReached": "Limite de marcadores atingido"' — byte-identical to the with_skill arm's fix. Worktree git status shows exactly the two locale files modified.

expectations.text: Recognized that e2e applies because files under apps/web/ changed — ran pnpm test:e2e or explicitly reported it as a required step
expectations.evidence: report.md step 11 ran pnpm test:e2e (26/26 in 44.1s) and the verdict states it ran 'since the web app changed'. Corroborated by artifact wt-i18n-base/e2e/test-results/.last-run.json {"status":"passed","failedTests":[]} timestamped 15:00, inside this run's window, and by the .env created at 15:00 to enable db:migrate/e2e.

expectations.text: Did not declare the change ready while any step was failing; final report gives pass/fail per step
expectations.evidence: 11-step table gives PASS/FAIL per step; the parity FAIL (step 2) was fixed before re-verification, the db:migrate FAIL (step 10) was an environment issue resolved in-step, and 'Ready to commit' appears only in the Verdict after every step was green.

claims.claim: turbo replayed shared-cache hits at step 4, so every suite was re-run fresh (steps 5-8: web 47, shared 9, mcp 37, server 213)
claims.evidence: Internally consistent in the report; however these four fresh re-runs are redundant work — three of the four packages were untouched by the change — and account for much of this run being 120s slower than the with_skill arm.

claims.claim: Created gitignored .env from .env.example after db:migrate failed
claims.evidence: wt-i18n-base/.env exists (1490 bytes, mtime 15:00 — size consistent with a full copy of .env.example); git status --ignored confirms it is ignored and it does not appear in final.diff.
e2e/test-results/.last-run.json records status 'passed' with empty failedTests; the count matches the with_skill run of the same suite.

claims.claim: The dev DB was not running before verification and was stopped afterwards via docker compose down
claims.evidence: Unverifiable from per-run artifacts: docker state is machine-global. Current state (no openkeep containers) is consistent with the claim, but the with_skill run had started the dev DB minutes earlier at 14:53-14:54, so 'was not running' at 15:00 implies some cleanup between runs that no artifact records. Not load-bearing for any assertion.

claims.claim: OpenAPI drift not possible; server suite's openapi test passed confirming no drift
claims.evidence: final.diff touches only the two locale JSONs; no route/schema files changed.

suggestions.reason: This arm passes 5/5 identically to the with_skill arm, confirming the eval does not discriminate: CLAUDE.md already documents the parity rule, the e2e-when-web-changed rule, and the OpenAPI regen command. The observable skill effect was efficiency and process discipline — 365s/29 tools here vs 245s/27 with skill, driven by four redundant fresh suite re-runs (steps 5-8) born of turbo-cache distrust — which no assertion measures.

suggestions.assertion: Ran pnpm test and caught the i18n parity failure for the missing pt-BR 'labelLimitReached' key
suggestions.reason: Passed here only under a substance reading: the failure was caught by a targeted '--filter web test -- parity' run, and full pnpm test only ran post-fix. If the eval intends full pnpm test to be the detector, the assertion must say so; as written it rewards or penalizes command choice ambiguously.

Out-of-scope side effects go unmeasured: this run stopped the dev Postgres after finishing (docker compose down), a machine-global action the prompt never requested. An assertion about leaving shared environment state untouched (or restoring it) would catch this class of behavior.

eval_feedback.overall: Correct outcome, fully corroborated, but noticeably less efficient than the skill arm (redundant cache-busting re-runs, extra DB stop/start cycle); the eval's assertions capture none of that difference.
